name: 02461 · Newton, MA
findings: ZIP 02461 (Newton) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02461 (Newton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02461 (Newton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
